Paragraph writing methods differ primarily in the placement of the main idea (topic sentence):

| Feature | Inductive Method | Deductive Method |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Structure** | Specific details/examples first $\rightarrow$ Main idea at the **end** | Main idea/topic sentence first $\rightarrow$ Supporting details follow |
| **Purpose** | Builds suspense, leads the reader to a logical conclusion | Directly states the point, saves time, highly suited for technical writing |
| **Example** | "Team members missed deadlines, communication channels broke down, and project requirements were ignored. *Therefore, poor planning is the root cause of project failure.*" | "*Poor planning is the root cause of project failure.* For instance, team members missed deadlines, communication channels broke down, and requirements were ignored." |
proTip: Deductive is preferred in technical and engineering reports because busy readers want the main point immediately.
